aria-label.zh-CN: 组合框的可访问名称，次于 `aria-labelledby`，优先于 insetLabel 的内容。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the combobox. It comes after `aria-labelledby` and before the insetLabel content.

arrowIcon.zh-CN: 自定义右侧下拉箭头，传入 `null` 时不显示箭头。
arrowIcon.en-US: Custom arrow icon on the right; `null` hides the arrow.

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 下拉被边缘遮挡时是否自动调整展开方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the dropdown flips its direction when an edge covers it.

autoMergeValue.zh-CN: 多选时，选中父节点后 value 不再包含它的子孙节点。`leafOnly` 也开启时，`leafOnly` 优先。
autoMergeValue.en-US: In multiple mode, once a parent is selected the value leaves out its descendants. When `leafOnly` is also on, `leafOnly` takes precedence.

bottomSlot.en-US: Content at the bottom of the dropdown.

borderless.en-US: Whether to use the borderless style.

changeOnSelect.zh-CN: 单选时是否允许选择非叶子节点。
changeOnSelect.en-US: Whether a non-leaf node can be selected in single mode.

checkRelation.zh-CN: 多选时节点之间的选中关系：`related` 为父子联动，`unRelated` 为互不影响。
checkRelation.en-US: In multiple mode, how checked states relate: `related` links parents and children, `unRelated` keeps them independent.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除按钮的图标，`showClear` 为 true 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom icon of the clear button; effective when `showClear` is true.

clickToSelect.zh-CN: 多选时点击任意节点即选中，常与 `showNext="hover"` 配合：悬停展开子菜单，点击选中当前节点。
clickToSelect.en-US: In multiple mode, clicking any node selects it. Often used with `showNext="hover"`: hovering expands the submenu and clicking selects the node.

defaultOpen.zh-CN: 是否在挂载时默认展开下拉。
defaultOpen.en-US: Whether the dropdown is open on mount.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 默认选中的条目，只在挂载时读取：单选为节点或路径，多选为路径数组。
defaultValue.en-US: The initially selected entry, read once on mount: a node or a path in single mode, an array of paths in multiple mode.

disableStrictly.zh-CN: 是否开启严格禁用。开启后，禁用的节点不会因父级或子级的选中关系改变选中状态。
disableStrictly.en-US: Whether strict disabling is on. A disabled node then does not change when its parent or children are checked.

displayProp.zh-CN: 回填到触发器与标签中的节点属性。
displayProp.en-US: The node field shown in the trigger and the tags.

displayRender.zh-CN: 自定义回填内容。单选时参数为路径上各级节点 label 的数组；多选时参数为节点的 Entity 与索引，返回每个标签的内容。
displayRender.en-US: Custom trigger content. In single mode it receives the array of labels on the path; in multiple mode it receives the Entity of a node and its index, and returns the content of its tag.

dropdownStyle.zh-CN: 下拉菜单的样式，可以是键为 kebab-case 的对象，也可以是字符串。
dropdownStyle.en-US: Style of the dropdown menu: an object with kebab-case keys, or a string.

emptyContent.zh-CN: 没有可选数据或搜索无结果时展示的内容，默认为「暂无数据」；传入 `null` 时不展示。
emptyContent.en-US: Content shown when there is no option or the search has no result; defaults to the locale text for no data, and `null` hides it.

enableLeafClick.zh-CN: 多选时，点击叶子节点的选项是否触发勾选。
enableLeafClick.en-US: In multiple mode, whether clicking the option of a leaf node checks it.

expandIcon.zh-CN: 自定义子菜单的展开图标。
expandIcon.en-US: Custom icon that marks a node with children.

filterLeafOnly.zh-CN: 搜索结果是否只展示叶子节点的路径。
filterLeafOnly.en-US: Whether the search results only show the paths of leaf nodes.

filterRender.zh-CN: 自定义渲染每一条搜索结果，参数为 `CascaderFilterRenderProps`。返回单个元素时，该元素获得选项的 `id`、`role="option"` 和选中状态；返回文本或多个节点时，组件包一层 `li`。
filterRender.en-US: Renders each search result; it receives `CascaderFilterRenderProps`. When a single element is returned, it gets the option's `id`, `role="option"` and the selected state; text or several nodes are wrapped in an `li`.

filterSorter.zh-CN: 对搜索结果排序。参数为两条结果路径（从根节点到匹配节点的节点数组）与输入内容，返回比较值。
filterSorter.en-US: Sorts the search results. It receives two result paths (the node arrays from the root to the matched node) and the input, and returns a comparison value.

filterTreeNode.zh-CN: 是否开启搜索。为 true 时按 `treeNodeFilterProp` 的值匹配输入，不区分大小写；也可以传入匹配函数，参数为输入内容、节点的属性字符串与节点数据。
filterTreeNode.en-US: Whether search is on. True matches the input against the `treeNodeFilterProp` value, case-insensitively. A match function receives the input, that string and the node data.

id.zh-CN: 选择框根元素（触发器）的 id。
id.en-US: The id of the trigger, which is the root element.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 嵌入触发器内的标签，作为组合框的名称来源；有 `prefix` 时不渲染。
insetLabel.en-US: Label inset in the trigger, which names the combobox; it is not rendered when `prefix` is set.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: insetLabel 内容的 id，用于关联组合框的名称；未设置时由组件生成。
insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the insetLabel content, used to name the combobox; the component generates one when it is not set.

keyMaps.zh-CN: 自定义节点中 value、label、children、disabled、isLeaf 的字段名。
keyMaps.en-US: Custom field names for value, label, children, disabled and isLeaf in a node.

leafOnly.zh-CN: 多选时 value 与标签只包含叶子节点。
leafOnly.en-US: In multiple mode, the value and the tags only include leaf nodes.

loadData.zh-CN: 异步加载数据，参数为从根到当前节点的路径，需要返回 Promise。不能与搜索同时使用。
loadData.en-US: Loads data asynchronously. It receives the path from the root to the current node and must return a Promise. Cannot be used with search.

max.zh-CN: 多选时选中数量的上限，超出后触发 `onExceed`。
max.en-US: In multiple mode, the most paths that can be selected; exceeding it calls `onExceed`.

maxTagCount.zh-CN: 多选时标签的最大展示数量，超出部分以 `+N` 展示。
maxTagCount.en-US: In multiple mode, the most tags shown; the rest appear as `+N`.

motion.zh-CN: 下拉框弹出时是否有动画。
motion.en-US: Whether the dropdown animates when it opens.

multiple.zh-CN: 是否多选。它改变 value、defaultValue、onChange、onSelect、displayRender 与 triggerRender 的类型，没有全局默认值。
multiple.en-US: Whether several paths can be selected. It changes the types of value, defaultValue, onChange, onSelect, displayRender and triggerRender; it has no global default.

onBlur.zh-CN: 失焦或关闭下拉时的回调，不是 DOM 的 blur 事件；通过 ref 的 `close()` 关闭时不传参数。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves or the dropdown closes; it is not the DOM blur event. Closing with the ref's `close()` passes no argument.

onChange.zh-CN: 选中项变化时的回调。参数为选中路径的 value 数组，多选时为路径数组；`onChangeWithObject` 为 true 时参数为节点数据。
onChange.en-US: Called when the selection changes, with the value path of the selection, or an array of paths in multiple mode; with `onChangeWithObject` set to true it receives node data.

onChangeWithObject.zh-CN: 为 true 时 onChange 的参数为节点数据（含 value 键），而不是 value；受控的 value 与 defaultValue 也要传节点数据。
onChangeWithObject.en-US: When true, onChange receives node data, which includes the value key, instead of values; a controlled value and defaultValue must then be node data too.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

onDropdownVisibleChange.zh-CN: 下拉展开或收起时的回调，参数为是否可见。
onDropdownVisibleChange.en-US: Called when the dropdown opens or closes, with whether it is visible.

onExceed.zh-CN: 多选时超出 `max` 后的回调，参数为已选中的 Entity 数组。
onExceed.en-US: In multiple mode, called when `max` is exceeded, with the array of checked Entity.

onFocus.zh-CN: 组合框获得焦点，或下拉被鼠标、键盘打开时的回调，不是 DOM 的 focus 事件。
onFocus.en-US: Called when the combobox gets focus, or the dropdown is opened by the mouse or the keyboard; it is not the DOM focus event.

onListScroll.zh-CN: 列视图中某一列滚动时的回调，参数为事件与 `{ panelIndex, activeNode }`；搜索结果列表的滚动不触发。
onListScroll.en-US: Called when a column scrolls, with the event and `{ panelIndex, activeNode }`; scrolling the search results does not call it.

onLoad.zh-CN: 节点加载完毕时的回调，参数为新加载的 key 集合与该节点的数据。
onLoad.en-US: Called when a node finishes loading, with the set of newly loaded keys and the data of that node.

onSearch.zh-CN: 搜索文本变化时的回调，参数为输入的内容。
onSearch.en-US: Called when the search text changes, with the input.

onSelect.zh-CN: 节点被选中时的回调，参数为选中项的 value；多选时只选中一个节点为单个值，否则为数组。
onSelect.en-US: Called when a node is selected, with its value; in multiple mode a single checked node gives its value, and more give an array.

position.zh-CN: 下拉的展开方向，默认 `bottomLeft`（RTL 下为 `bottomRight`）。
position.en-US: Direction of the dropdown, `bottomLeft` by default and `bottomRight` in RTL.

prefix.zh-CN: 前缀标签，渲染在触发器内左侧。
prefix.en-US: Prefix shown on the left inside the trigger.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内的 focus 是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示获得焦点的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing inside the component stops the browser scrolling the document to show the focused element.

ref.zh-CN: 接收触发器元素，该元素挂有下方 Methods 中的 open、close、focus、blur 与 search 方法。
ref.en-US: Receives the trigger element, which carries the open, close, focus, blur and search methods listed under Methods.

remote.zh-CN: 是否开启远程搜索。开启后输入不再做本地过滤，只触发 `onSearch`，由使用方异步更新 `treeData`。
remote.en-US: Whether to search remotely. Input is then not filtered locally; only `onSearch` is called, and the caller updates `treeData` asynchronously.

renderLabel.zh-CN: 自定义列视图中选项的内容，参数为节点数据；搜索结果、回显与标签仍显示节点的 label 文本。
renderLabel.en-US: Renders the content of an option in the columns; it receives the node data. The search results, the selection and the tags still show the node's label text.

restTagsPopoverProps.zh-CN: 剩余标签 Popover 的属性，如 `position`、`trigger`，类型同 PopoverProps。
restTagsPopoverProps.en-US: Props of the Popover that shows the remaining tags, such as `position` and `trigger`; the type is PopoverProps.

searchPlaceholder.zh-CN: 搜索框的占位文字，未设置时使用 `placeholder`。
searchPlaceholder.en-US: Placeholder of the search input; `placeholder` is used when it is not set.

searchPosition.zh-CN: 搜索框的位置：`trigger` 在触发器内，`custom` 由使用方自定义，此时用 ref 的 `search` 方法传入搜索词。
searchPosition.en-US: Where the search input is: `trigger` puts it in the trigger, `custom` leaves it to the caller, who passes the keyword with the ref's `search` method.

separator.zh-CN: 路径的分隔符，用于搜索结果，以及单选时回填到触发器的内容。
separator.en-US: Separator between the levels of a path, used in the search results and in the trigger in single mode.

showClear.en-US: Whether to show the clear button.

showNext.zh-CN: 展开子菜单的时机：`click` 或 `hover`。

showRestTagsPopover.zh-CN: 超出 `maxTagCount` 后，悬停 `+N` 时是否用 Popover 展示剩余标签。
showRestTagsPopover.en-US: Once `maxTagCount` is exceeded, whether hovering `+N` shows the remaining tags in a Popover.

size.zh-CN: 选择框的尺寸，可选 `small`、`default`、`large`。在 InputGroup 中时以 InputGroup 的尺寸为准。
size.en-US: Size of the select box: `small`, `default` or `large`. Inside an InputGroup the group's size takes its place.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止下拉框上的点击事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether clicks on the dropdown stop bubbling.

suffix.zh-CN: 后缀标签，渲染在触发器内右侧。
suffix.en-US: Suffix shown on the right inside the trigger.

topSlot.en-US: Content at the top of the dropdown.

treeNodeFilterProp.zh-CN: 搜索时用于匹配输入的节点属性。
treeNodeFilterProp.en-US: The node field matched against the search input.

triggerRender.zh-CN: 自定义触发器的渲染，参数为 `TriggerRenderProps`，返回的元素替换默认的触发器内容。
triggerRender.en-US: Renders a custom trigger; it receives `TriggerRenderProps`, and the element it returns replaces the default trigger content.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 触发器的校验状态，可选 `default`、`error`、`warning`，只影响样式。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status of the trigger: `default`, `error` or `warning`; it only affects the style.

value.zh-CN: 受控的选中条目，类型同 `defaultValue`。传入后即为受控组件，配合 `onChange` 更新。
value.en-US: The selected entry under control, typed like `defaultValue`. Passing it makes the component controlled, to be updated with `onChange`.

virtualizeInSearch.zh-CN: 搜索结果的虚拟列表配置，由 `height`、`width`、`itemSize` 组成，用于结果很多的场景；`height` 缺省为 180。
virtualizeInSearch.en-US: Virtual list of the search results, made of `height`, `width` and `itemSize`, for large result sets; `height` defaults to 180.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦组合框（搜索框或触发器），不展开下拉。
focus.en-US: Focuses the combobox, which is the search input or the trigger, without opening the dropdown.

search.zh-CN: 按传入的文本搜索，需同时设置 `filterTreeNode`；`searchPosition` 为 `custom` 时由使用方自定义展示搜索框。
search.en-US: Searches as if the text were typed; needs `filterTreeNode`, and with `searchPosition` set to `custom` the caller draws the search input.
